dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses /var/tmp/ file paths and LINE SEQUENTIAL files typical of GnuCOBOL on Unix

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - accounting/billing card input component (会計カード入力 J02)
purpose.summary: This program is the accounting card input component (J02) of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt system used by Japanese medical clinics. It handles patient insurance billing data entry, including treatment history, hospitalization records, insurance combination management, and receipt calculation. It is a large interactive batch/screen program managing SPA (scratchpad area) files for inter-program communication.

notable_features: Large SPA (scratchpad area) file-based inter-program communication via LINE SEQUENTIAL files in /var/tmp/
65 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (CPJ02SPASCR.INC, COMMON-SPA, J01COMMON-SPA, J02SCR-SPA, ENUM-VALUE)
98 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
480 PERFORM statements with 130 GOTOs indicating complex procedural flow
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments throughout (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - pure file-based architecture
REDEFINES used for display formatting (SURYO, TENSU fields)
Extensive flag and index working storage areas
Version history from 2000-2004 with multiple maintainers (MCC, NACL)
verdict.notes: File is 345KB / 8296 lines - a large production program. Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded but decoded as latin-1, appearing as mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated to first 16000 chars; full procedure division not visible but structural indicators confirm production-grade complexity.
